firmographics.narrative_md:
Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE: RF) is a publicly traded bank holding company incorporated in Delaware and headquartered at 1900 Fifth Avenue North, Birmingham, Alabama. Founded in 1971, Regions Financial Corporation is the parent company of Regions Bank — an Alabama state-chartered commercial bank and member of the Federal Reserve System. As a Bank Holding Company (BHC) supervised by the Federal Reserve under the Bank Holding Company Act, Regions Financial submits annual 10-K filings and CCAR stress test results to the Federal Reserve.

Regions Bank holds FDIC deposit insurance and is jointly examined by the Federal Reserve and Alabama Banking Department. Dan Massey (Chief Enterprise Operations and Technology Officer) joined from Truist Bank in May 2022 and reports directly to CEO John Turner. As of March 31, 2026, Anil Chadha serves as Chief Financial Officer, succeeding David Turner who retired after 20 years. Evidence: E-001, E-007, E-009, E-058.

Regions Business Bank is a $200.0B in assets regional bank regulated by Federal Reserve, operating since 1971 with 23,000 employees. A 16.2% multi-year growth rate gives it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-001, E-012]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.4/5. The deepest capability gap is Change Management Framework at 2.1/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-007, E-014]. Next is Abandonment Recovery at 2.1/5 against a 3.5 peer median [E-002].

Third is RTO/RPO Achievement at 2.2/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-058, E-065]. The issue register adds Run ID found fewer than 2 times in report (high severity). The issue register adds 4 range-style E-ID references: ['E-001 to E-091', 'E-001 to E-091'] (high severity). Counter-signal: Governance & Ethics — a lower-scoring capability area already runs at 2.7/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The roster shows no CDO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below.

The question for Regions Business Bank is whether to close Change Management Framework first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Regions Business Bank should lead with Databricks (73/100 fit) against Data Quality Governance, then sequence nCino behind it. Closing Change Management Framework to the peer median alone is worth 0.9 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
